items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Frist: zwei Wochen nach dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: The attached Zustellungsurkunde (page 2) documents actual formal delivery ('zugestellt am') on 21.05.2026 (Thursday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted; the period runs from the next day. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period stated in weeks ends with the day of the second week that, by name, corresponds to the day of the triggering event (Thursday). Two weeks after Thursday 21.05.2026 is Thursday 04.06.2026. However, 04.06.2026 is Fronleichnam (Corpus Christi), a statutory public holiday in Bayern. Per § 193 BGB, if the last day of a period falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday at the place of performance, the period ends on the next business day, i.e. Friday 05.06.2026.

items.title: Pay total fine amount (Gesamtbetrag) once the decision is final
items.quote: Zahlung: Gesamtbetrag binnen zwei Wochen ab Rechtskraft auf das unten angegebene Konto (Verwendungszweck: Aktenzeichen).
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks 'ab Rechtskraft' (from legal finality of the decision), which only occurs if no Einspruch is filed within the deadline computed above (05.06.2026). Assuming no Einspruch is lodged, the decision becomes rechtskräftig the day after the Einspruch period lapses, i.e. Saturday 06.06.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB that day of Rechtskraft is excluded from the count; the two-week period starts 07.06.2026 and, under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends two weeks later on the day matching the weekday name of the Rechtskraft event (Saturday), i.e. 20.06.2026. Since that day is a Saturday, under § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 22.06.2026. This date is only valid if no Einspruch is filed; filing an Einspruch would suspend Rechtskraft and this payment obligation entirely.

warnings: The payment deadline ('binnen zwei Wochen ab Rechtskraft') is contingent on no Einspruch being filed by 2026-06-05; the computed payment due date of 2026-06-22 is only an estimate and does not apply if an Einspruch is lodged.
